text_block_list.text: (Sigh... this season has come around again...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, why don't we set up
a day to train together!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, this kid's way too energetic, y'see.
It'd really help if she had a fellow downer around... What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Listen, listen! We were just talking about swimming over to that island on an adventure!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Looks like it's gonna be a fun summer training camp!
Looks like we're gonna have a fun summer training camp, huh!

text_block_list.text: And so, the third summer training camp with Narita Taishin began!
